preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Saved on your profile, so they follow you to other devices.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing the password signs you out everywhere else.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: A second step at sign-in protects your account even if your password leaks.
mfa.requiredByPolicy: Your organisation requires two-step verification for your account.

sessions.title: Where you are signed in
sessions.description: End any session you do not recognise.
sessions.endOthers: Sign out of all other sessions

tokens.title: Personal access tokens
tokens.description: Tokens let scripts and integrations call the API as you, with your permissions. Treat them like passwords.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.copyNow: Copy the token now. It will not be shown again.
tokens.revokeDescription: Anything using it stops working immediately.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.description: Let a colleague approve on your behalf while you are away. Every approval records that it was on your behalf.
delegations.noEmployee: Your account is not linked to an employee, so delegations are not available.
